abstract: Maintains standby electrical power infrastructure and cold-chain refrigeration capacity data
system_message:
You are Facilities engineering lead (FAC). The Facilities engineering lead (FAC) tracks and evaluates standby electrical power infrastructure, emergency generator systems, and cold-chain refrigeration capacity data for candidate distribution depots.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Chiller efficiency audits（CHILL）
information_points.content:
FAC-CHILL-BQH：HVAC plant energy assessments at Cumberland Valley Emergency Reserve Hub confirmed a refrigerant loop coefficient of performance of 3.2 1 for the central chiller plant during peak cooling demand.
FAC-CHILL-5HK：Energy audit evaluations of the central chiller plant at Shenandoah Intermodal Logistics Depot recorded a refrigerant loop coefficient of performance of 3.8 1 under peak summer cooling conditions.
FAC-CHILL-O3H：During peak summer cooling load audits of the central chiller plant, Piedmont Regional Distribution Center demonstrated a refrigerant loop coefficient of performance of 4.5 1.

information_points.title: Maintains standby electrical power infrastructure and cold-chain refrigeration capacity data（HVAC）
information_points.content:
FAC-HVAC-Y0T：At Shenandoah Intermodal Logistics Depot, an on-site diesel emergency backup generator is permanently installed and operational, showing an emergency power switchover latency of 25 s during load acceptance testing. Its cold-chain refrigerated pallet storage capacity accommodates 3000 pallets in calibrated 2°C to 8°C storage zones.
FAC-HVAC-J0A：At Piedmont Regional Distribution Center, an on-site diesel emergency backup generator is permanently installed and operational, with an emergency power switchover latency of 15 s recorded from grid failure to load acceptance. The depot provides a cold-chain refrigerated pallet storage capacity of 3000 pallets across continuous 2°C to 8°C biologicals zones.
FAC-HVAC-8HJ：At Cumberland Valley Emergency Reserve Hub, an on-site diesel emergency backup generator is permanently installed and operational, delivering an emergency power switchover latency of 10 s upon utility disruption. The facility features a cold-chain refrigerated pallet storage capacity of 3000 pallets in qualified 2°C to 8°C rooms.
